root_cause.text: KVM allowed userspace to clear the KVM_MEM_GUEST_MEMFD flag on an existing memslot originally created with guest_memfd, without unbinding from the guest_memfd instance, resulting in a use-after-free when the guest_memfd was released.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `KVM_MEM_GUEST_MEMFD` to the flags that are rejected when toggling on an existing memslot. The commit message explicitly states: "Reject attempts to disable KVM_MEM_GUEST_MEMFD on a memslot that was initially created with a guest_memfd binding, as KVM doesn't support toggling ... Failure to reject the new memslot results in a use-after-free due to KVM not unbinding from the guest_memfd instance." The KASAN trace confirms a slab-use-after-free in `kvm_gmem_release` after a `kvm_set_memslot` operation freed the memslot.
